ga.title: Google Analytics
ga.intro: Give each site that should report to Google Analytics its GA4 Measurement ID. The tag loads only after a visitor accepts the cookie banner, and nothing is sent to Google before that.
ga.invalid: A Measurement ID looks like G- followed by letters and digits.
ga.uploaded: Uploaded files: add the Google tag to your bundle yourself.
ga.noSites: This workspace has no sites yet.
ga.saved: Measurement IDs saved. Live sites pick them up within about five minutes; no republish needed.
ga.public: A Measurement ID is public: it appears in every page that loads the tag. It is not a secret.
ga.pageViews: Page views come from Google's own enhanced measurement. Keep "Page changes based on browser history events" on in your GA data stream so single-page sites count each page.
ga.disabled: This plugin is disabled, so no site loads Google Analytics.
